description: Inventory of the curated BioModels corpus: the corpus identity, the per-record outcome of the modern Atomizer in the flat and the atomized mode, and the classification of every residual failure and timeout.  The harness owns every status; this file only reduces its reports and adds the corpus identity.
label: curated-biomodels-corpus

measurement.note: The per-record status is the status the reduced harness report records.  The effect of the change under review is stated separately, in residuals.branch_effect, with the records it touches and where they were measured.

branch_effect.note: The records the change under review touches, measured record by record with the corpus gate's --only-id path on the branch and on main with the same native extension.

BIOMD0000000245.cause: The rule names seven reaction ids.  The flux inlining replaced one reaction per pass and stopped after four passes, so the remaining ids reached the emitted rule as unresolved expression symbols and the model did not compile.
BIOMD0000000245.construct: reaction id used as a rate inside a rule

BIOMD0000000353.cause: A species assignment rule names a compartment whose size an initial assignment sets; the compartment was rewritten to the constant volume parameter, producing a call to an undeclared function.
BIOMD0000000353.construct: compartment size set by an initialAssignment

BIOMD0000000570.cause: The rate rule names seven reaction ids; the same four-pass limit left three of them unresolved.
BIOMD0000000570.construct: reaction id used as a rate inside a rate rule

BIOMD0000000638.cause: The scaled compartment size was one unit in the last place away from the value the source states, and the independent oracle failed to converge on it.
BIOMD0000000638.construct: compartment size in a scaled unit

BIOMD0000000954.cause: A state-dependent rate law was replaced by a numerically fitted constant, so the exported model was not the model the source states.
BIOMD0000000954.construct: rate law that names a species the reaction does not consume

BIOMD0000001098.cause: Every kinetic law is an <apply> whose operator is a <ci> naming a parameter, which MathML reads as a call to an undeclared function; the emitted rule did not parse.  The construct is now reported as a loss.
